checks_performed.details: Shelf recognition, masculine without stereotyping, quality, logo/wordmark legibility, and multi-SKU extensibility are each scored out of 10 for A, B, C, and D.
Ranking recorded as B, C, A, D.
Two priorities are recorded for B: brand/SKU hierarchy and production robustness of metallic fine-line graphics.
Shelf recognition is weighted 30% and logo/wordmark legibility 25%; the remaining criteria are weighted 15% each.
Both JSON files parsed successfully with jq.

limitations: The board does not show a separate brand logo, so the requested logo-legibility criterion was assessed using the primary front-facing wordmark.
Only a front-view rendered board was supplied; substrate, finish, side/back panels, regulatory copy, physical size, and actual retail lighting were not available for verification.
